abilities.name: Life Support
abilities.text: Use when another Friendly Biological Unit suffers Damage Within 4″. Reduce the Total Damage before allocation by 1 for each model in this Unit that is Within 4″ of the damaged Unit.

abilities.name: Restoration
abilities.text: Use when a Friendly Unit Within 4″ receives a DEBUFF. Remove all DEBUFFS from it.

abilities.name: Medpack
abilities.text: Select another Friendly Biological Unit Within 4″. Resolve the HEAL (X) effect for the targeted Unit, where X is the number of models in this Unit that are Within 4″ of the target Unit.

abilities.name: Optical Flare
abilities.text: Select one Enemy Unit Within 12″. Until the End of the Round, apply DEBUFF Range (4) to that Unit's Ranged Weapons. That Unit cannot benefit from LONG RANGE.

upgrades.name: A-13 Flash Grenade Launcher
upgrades.text: Increase the Optical Flare special ability's Range to 16″.

upgrades.name: Advanced Medic Facilities
upgrades.text: This Unit's Supply Value counts as 0 when calculating the Supply Pool.

upgrades.name: Stabilizer Medpacks
upgrades.text: When this Unit resolves a Life Support or Medpack ability, treat it as having 1 additional model Within Range for calculating that ability's effects.
